{{Field procedure|summary=Mark unwanted resources in the Contacts panel so autonomous collector limpets leave them in space.}}

Use this procedure during a [[Mining|mining]] run when autonomous collector limpets are retrieving fragments or canisters that do not fit the current cargo plan. Collector limpets do not retrieve contacts marked '''Ignored'''.<ref name="collector">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Collector_Limpet_Controller Collector Limpet Controller], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>

The ignore list filters collection. It does not remove cargo already aboard or clear partial [[Refinery|refinery]] bins. A mixed fragment may still be collected when it also contains a wanted resource.

== Before you start ==

* Decide which mined commodities and Engineering materials the run should keep.
* Make sure at least one fragment, chunk, material, or canister of the unwanted resource is within sensor range and visible in the Contacts panel.
* If possible, set the filters before deploying autonomous collectors; an active collector may retrieve a nearby object before the new setting is made.
* Do not ignore raw Engineering materials merely to save cargo space. Materials use separate storage and do not occupy refinery bins or cargo racks.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Open the ship's left-hand panel and select the '''Contacts''' tab.
# Select a nearby fragment, chunk, material, or canister containing a resource that should not be collected.
# Choose the unwanted named resource, then select '''Add to Ignore List'''. A fragment can contain more than one resource, so check which component the action applies to.<ref name="inara-mining">[https://inara.cz/elite/squadron-document/7746/2315 Empire Tech and Trade Institute — Mining Guide], INARA. Accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>
# Repeat the action for each unwanted resource currently present.
# Launch or continue autonomous collector limpets with no individual collectable targeted. They will leave contacts containing only ignored resources in space.<ref name="collector" />
# Check the refinery after the collectors resume. Vent unwanted partial bins separately if they are occupying space needed for the intended commodities.<ref name="refinery">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Refinery Refinery], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>
}}

== Completion check ==

The filter is working when autonomous collectors stop selecting contacts that contain only ignored resources while continuing to retrieve wanted fragments, materials, or canisters.

A mixed fragment can still be collected when it contains a wanted component. If an unwanted refinery bin continues to gain progress, inspect the collected fragments for mixed contents rather than assuming that the ignore setting failed.

== Removing an ignore setting ==

When a resource becomes useful again, select a dimmed contact containing it in the Contacts panel and use the same contact control to remove it from the ignore list.<ref name="frontier-thread">[https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/materials-ignore-list-is-there-any-way-to-reset-the-entire-list.456906/ Materials Ignore List: is there any way to reset the entire list?], Frontier Forums community discussion. Accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>

If no matching contact is present, create or locate one before trying to change that resource's setting. Review old ignore choices when changing the objective of a mining or material-collection run.

== Common problems ==

* '''Add to Ignore List is unavailable:''' select the collectable contact itself rather than the asteroid, prospector limpet, or refinery bin. The object must be detected and shown in Contacts.
* '''Collectors still retrieve an unwanted component:''' the fragment may also contain a wanted resource. The collector retrieves the whole fragment when any eligible component remains.
* '''The refinery remains blocked:''' ignoring future collections does not vent existing bins or move completed tonnes into a full cargo hold. Continue with [[How to Resolve a Full Refinery]].
* '''A collector expires after one delivery:''' it was launched while a collectable object was targeted and entered single-target mode. Deselect collectable contacts before launching autonomous collectors; see [[How to Use Collector Limpets]].
* '''A needed material is not being collected:''' select a nearby dimmed contact for that material and remove it from the ignore list.
